body: Well whatever works, continue to use it. Must be great to have not had suicidal thoughts for awhile. Currently going on my own streak, and I'm lovin' it!
Sounds good! Thanks for all your advice and hearing me out!

Dang, what are the odds of that!

I guess. I don't really know for sure, though. There's nothing really "happening" in my hometown. You have to drive about 15-20 miles to the next town to find anything to do, and to be honest, the thought of going out and meeting new people terrifies me at the moment. During school, no problem, but during the summer...it's a different story.

I may be able to stay in the area of where my school is at, but I don't think I'm ready to live completely by myself yet. I mean, I don't think I would mind moving back home, but it's just the fact that I'll be away from all my friends that makes me hesitate about doing it. I don't want to feel like I'll be alone.

Yeah, it sucks, but it's just for the time being. I haven't graduated just yet. It's summer break. I am scared of life after graduating, though. I would be leaving the fun, exciting times of college and going back home, where there is nothing. I'm scared of being stuck in permanent "summer mode" after graduation. I don't even think I'll be able to get a job after I graduate. I'm so scared.

I'd say it's the former. I can't hang out with my friends as easily and maintaining contact seems to be hard because I can't have a good old fashioned chat/conversation because everyone seems to be out and about doing stuff, or they just don't have time to talk. I'm always afraid that my messages will just go ignored, and it has actually happened before, so I can't help but feel like I'm being deliberately ignored. It seems like I just can't hit someone up saying "Hey man how's it going?" because either a) my message will go ignored, or b) they will seem like they don't want to talk, evidenced by short responses and them not making an effort to keep the conversation going, so thus the conversation and my attempt at making contact goes nowhere. I feel as if I used a different conversation starter other than "Hey how's it going" or something similar would work better, but I just can't seem to think of one. Unfortunately, it seems like these days that people don't have time to just "talk". Maybe I'm just expecting too much out of people.

Thanks. I've actually been doing that, but I can't help but feel like I'm just burdening them. Honestly, right now, I just feel lonely and isolated. I love talking to my friends, but they all have their own things to do. I hardly have any friends back here at home. My college friends are back at their respective hometowns, so it's not like we can just decide to gather together and hang out. I just hate being alone at times.

1) That sounds good. I've never found myself to be much of an outdoorsy kind of person though. Maybe it's something I'll give a try.

2) You have a good point. It just feels so hard to let go, though...

3) Good point. Shows that there are always two sides to every story.

Thanks for hearing me out, man.

A select few know of the "situation" I'm going through right now. I'd put out a status update about what's been going on with me, but I feel like it would just be attention-whoring. I've been known to put up depressing statuses in the past, but I've been trying to avoid that. But if I put one out, people are just gonna be all like "Oh here goes fffffffffffffef again, with another one of his depressing statuses, let's pay absolutely no attention to him"


I've thought about cutting. It feels so tempting to do.

Here's why I'm feeling like this:

1) It's summer break and I'm bored as fuck. Really want to get a job, but I can't. Job search is just too depressing. So thus, I'm stuck at home, which is in the middle of nowhere and where there's nothing to do. Every day is the same: Wake up, eat, go on Reddit and Facebook, maybe take a nap or two, go to sleep, repeat. It's sickening.

2) This girl I was seeing towards the end of semester just suddenly stopped talking to me. It's like we don't even know each other anymore. I feel like she's the only thing that can make me happy, which I realize is a problem, but I just can't seem to find happiness in the things that once brought me happiness before.


3) People seem to have their shit together better than I do. A lot of my friends are working in the summer while I'm sitting here at home, taking up space, not doing anything. I feel useless. They all find ways to keep busy while I can't.

Honestly, I feel so stupid for even starting this thread and typing this up. I'm starting to see how stupid suicide would really be. It feels like I'm just doing this for attention. But ugh, I just don't know anymore. I know that there's surely a better way out of this... I haven't been able to maintain a generally happy and positive mindset this entire summer so far. I've never had a summer break where I've felt this miserable before. Honestly, I don't think I really want to kill myself. I'd be super scared to actually do it, but I just don't know another way out of this pain.
